locked_title: Multi-objective Evolution Algorithm based on Non-Dominated Sorting and Bidirectional Local Search for Investment Effectiveness Strategy Optimization

datasets.action: identified branch rating increase by a preregistered MVA increment
datasets.cost_unit: synthetic benchmark units unless a traceable calibration is frozen

datasets.action: identified line rating increase by a preregistered MVA increment
datasets.cost_unit: synthetic benchmark units unless a traceable calibration is frozen

local_search.move_acceptance: strict decrease in frozen normalized objective sum plus lambda times normalized violation
local_search.pass_rule: first improvement; stop at first non-improvement

baselines.scope: stage-local constrained NSGA-II already disclosed in p6_s3_matched_effort
stage-local add-delete-swap PLS already disclosed in p6_s3_matched_effort

excluded_comparators.reason: no audited task-aligned implementation and fair tuning contract exists in this worktree; exclusion is not a performance claim

pairing: within task family, pair all six methods by the same formal seed index; family-specific seed values differ; no replacement seeds

pilot.purpose: accounting, cache, constraint, move-semantics, metric, and environment validation only

protocols.termination: first reached cap; retain unique shortfall

evaluation_accounting.requested_evaluations: every scoring request including cache hits
evaluation_accounting.unique_evaluations: cache-miss canonical phenotypes scored once within a run
evaluation_accounting.cache_hits: requested evaluations served without a unique charge
evaluation_accounting.cache_scope: one shared population/local-search cache per run
evaluation_accounting.repair_charge: repair itself is uncharged; the repaired phenotype is charged on first scoring

primary_outcomes.normalization: family-specific analytic bounds frozen before pilot

secondary_outcomes.reference_rule: within family, instance, and protocol: nondominated union of all frozen methods and all 30 formal seeds under the same normalization

comparison_family.secondary_igd_plus: same contrasts in separately corrected families

multiplicity.correction: Holm separately within each task-family x outcome x orthogonal-or-baseline family

failure_policy.infrastructure_retry: at most once with identical inputs, hashes, environment, method, and seed; retain both attempts
failure_policy.algorithmic_failure: no retry for exceptions, non-finite objectives, cap shortfall, or empty feasible front
failure_policy.paired_analysis: contrast-specific complete paired blocks with every exclusion and reason reported
failure_policy.downgrade_rule: more than 3 of 30 unavailable blocks or method-dependent failures makes the contrast descriptive and inconclusive

negative_result_policy.protected_historical_result: under the prior primary matched-evaluation family BiLo-NSGA loses four of eight NSGA-II comparisons and wins none
